reading.action: Meditate to full stamina+focus on the safe platform, return to the floor-5 gallery, deliberately do NOT sense the enemies, channel Ember into the ember-bound chain+core to add a burning quality, grip Burning Anger in the tight-CoG flail handling, and spin-travel in a 360 burning whirlwind across the room toward the far exit.

engine.band: CLEAN (M>=12): deterrent +6 (eff pair-def 20) + heat-flinch -> pair graze only (x0.25)
engine.flailOffense: Chain Whip Novice base 14 + ember-burn x1.4, gate x1.0 neutral (blind), vs physDef 11; sweeps both hard, does NOT kill (moving past)
engine.outcome: CROSSES the gallery clean; arrives at the DEEP DEN threshold (deeper, gated, NOT out)

reading.result: REST-TO-FULL + BLIND HEATED SPIN-TRAVEL CROSS -- iris-prep full ruling (grounded vs floor-05.json). (1) Meditated to full on the safe platform (stamina 76/76, focus 120/120, no backlash, floor-5 reset moot). (2) Re-entered the gallery and channeled Ember into the bound chain+core -> a burning flail (x1.4 bash+burn), FED BY THE MAUL CORE which drew MODERATE->LOW across the cross; focus -10. (3) BLIND SPIN-TRAVEL = a SOUND second solution to the gallery (vs the designed mirror-read): the 360 heated whirlwind DENIES THE FLANK and refusing-to-sense/accept DENIES THE TRUST-STRIKE -- both of the pair's lethal mechanisms neutralized, the faked-heat trap has nothing to corrupt (he isn't sensing). Pair drop to physical harriers. PRIMARY ROLL: FIN 14 + intent 6 + Force-sense control aid +2 + roll 10 = 32 vs DC 15 -> margin 17 = CLEAN band: pair GRAZE ONLY (x0.25), HP -6; his flail sweeps both hard but does NOT kill (moving past). Pair end SINGED + BASHED, ALIVE, fall behind at the den threshold (bypass = reset, NO permanent kill). (4) CHAIN WHIP IS BORN -- first live combat use = the pre-staged 3rd consolidating event; system_card FIRES -> SKILL — Chain Whip (2nd live generator card). Ember-burn stays a SEPARATE composing Ember Channel application. NO Force tick (passive own-core torque-read). (3b) FLOOR GATED: the 'far exit' is the DEEP DEN, not out -- crossing presses him DEEPER; he lands at the den threshold, BLIND, with a faint new wrongness (colder, more total ahead). HELD DARK protected (mirror-solution, den tier-4 + cross-reference, the Host/boss, trust-ambush, lantern arc, the pair's true forms/count, deeper-not-out) -- he routed around the design, the resolution reveals only that the blind-burn-cross PASSED the room. POOLS: hp 124->118, focus 110/120, stamina 60/76, core LOW. Ch5 OPEN. NO Tower reset.
